config_contents.description: Equal-weight linear pool of EMOS, quantile regression and the DRN, September-initialized ONDJ (scripts/stack_benchmark.py, docs/54 section 3g).
config_contents.note: The members are read from their accepted runs' saved predictions (scripts/predictions.py): Phase 2 for EMOS and quantile regression, the pooled network (refitted in neural_pooled2) for the months, the stage-1 DRN for the season.

pathway: B: rainfall-distribution models from the raw ensemble, combined (equal-weight linear pool)

stack.name: Equal-weight pool of EMOS, quantile regression and the DRN
stack.fitting: none: the members fitted in their own benchmarks

drn_csg.name: Distributional regression network (DRN), censored shifted gamma
drn_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_csg.predictors: m', ensemble median, s', md', ensemble 10% and 90% quantiles (relative), log climatological mean, CHIRPS coefficient of variation, latitude, longitude
drn_csg.fitting: shared MLP (32 or 32-16 ELU units) -> CSG parameters; CRPS + weight decay; early stopping on held-out years; architecture and decay by validation CRPS, pooled

drn_pooled.name: DRN pooled over the months of a cycle
drn_pooled.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_pooled.predictors: the DRN inputs and the month's position in the season (one-hot)
drn_pooled.fitting: one network for the four months (pooled_benchmark.py), otherwise as the DRN

emos_csg.name: EMOS, censored shifted gamma
emos_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero
emos_csg.predictors: ensemble mean m' and mean absolute difference md' (relative)

quantile_regression.name: Regularized quantile regression
quantile_regression.estimates: conditional quantiles at 19 levels (5–95%), CDF by interpolation
quantile_regression.predictors: ensemble mean m' and spread s' (relative)
quantile_regression.fitting: pinball loss per level (Huber-smoothed), L2 1e-4, pooled

references.incumbent: MVS -> smoothed counts -> climatology blend (published probabilities)

accepted.note: equal-weight linear pool of EMOS, quantile regression and the DRN (pooled over the months; per target for the season); 25 members, scoring v2
